messages:
Aisha Kaur: quick heads-up — saw a 24h blip in error rate for a few high-usage accounts, mainly 5xx + timeouts. dropping the quick slice here for triage.

cs-ops-bot: ALERT: 5xx spike detected on routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream (threshold 5% exceeded) :warning:

Marco Liu: thanks. can you paste the top failing endpoints + counts? also which accounts are affected?

Aisha Kaur: sure — top failing endpoints (24h window):
```
/v1/generate          5xx: 1,240  timeouts: 310  rate-limit: 45
/v1/chat/stream      5xx:   890  timeouts: 520  rate-limit: 60
/v1/embeddings       5xx:   120  timeouts: 30   rate-limit: 4
/health/check         5xx:    22  timeouts: 5    rate-limit: 0
```
Affected accounts (top 3): BrightScale, ClearPoint, Novapay — BrightScale accounts for ~58% of failed tokens.

Taylor Chen: tagging @Ravi Patel — BrightScale is on Dedicated. did their pool autoscale OK? any Recent deploys?

Ravi Patel: BrightScale had a config tweak yesterday (batching window reduced). Not a deploy. Dedicated pool autoscaled once but latency still spiked. I can pull kernel-level logs.

Aisha Kaur: quick signal-level notes: 5xxs concentrated on long-context requests (>4k tokens) hitting kv cache eviction. timeouts correlate with bursts from a single API key (BrightScale-prod). Rate-limit hits small but present on /chat/stream — likely clients retrying on timeouts.

Marco Liu: action items: 1) Ravi to fetch runtime logs for kv/cache evictions (Ravi: ETA?), 2) ask BrightScale to slow client-side retries + add jitter, 3) temporary routing to compatible lower-memory model to reduce kv pressure.

Ravi Patel: will pull logs now, should have first dump in ~25m. linking datadog query and raw log sample when ready.

Taylor Chen: I can open a short enablement note for BrightScale: recommend retry jitter + smaller seq chunking. Also offer a canary on a 13B quantized model. cc @Aisha Kaur. :thumbsup:

Aisha Kaur: thanks. I'll notify CS lead + include a summary in this week's account health check-in doc. provisional risk to renewal: low if BrightScale accepts mitigations, medium if errors persist past 48h.

cs-ops-bot: NOTE: created incident ticket #INC-2026-334 (priority: P2) and assigned to eng-runtime on-call.

Marco Liu: perfect. update thread when logs are in or if BrightScale pushes a change.

Ravi Patel: log dump posted: https://app.datadog.example/logs?query=kv_eviction+BrightScale (raw sample below)
```
[2026-07-14T09:12:03Z] EVICT key=kv_324 size=4096 reason=memory_pressure model=redwood-13b seq_len=5780
[2026-07-14T09:12:03Z] REQUEST id=req_7f2 model=redwood-13b user=BrightScale status=timeout latency=12.3s
[2026-07-14T09:12:04Z] 5xx id=req_7f3 code=502 reason="kernel oom"
```

Aisha Kaur: that aligns with hypothesis. Ravi — can you attach memory usage heatmap? Marco/Taylor I'll draft the customer note.

Taylor Chen: drafting note now, will propose: small client retry jitter + limit seq_len to 4k while we test routing. sending draft in 15m.

Marco Liu: thanks team. we'll reconvene if error rate doesn't drop 30% after BrightScale applies mitigations. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
